what_this_is: A Wormhole VAA verifier live on Base Sepolia. It recovers guardian signatures over a Pyth attestation and refuses anything short of quorum — so a settlement conditioned on a price no longer depends on our adapter having checked it.
what_changed: Before this, verification_level ADAPTER_SIGNATURE_VERIFIED meant 'our adapter recovered the guardian signatures and signed the result'. A reader was trusting us to have checked. Now the chain recovers them, and a stranger can repeat the check with nothing of ours.
what_this_still_trusts: The Wormhole guardian federation and Pyth's publisher aggregate. A quorum of guardians signing an accumulator root proves the network published it; it does not prove the number was right, and no signature scheme could.
what_it_does_not_do: It stops at the VAA. Extracting an individual price means walking Pyth's Merkle profile, which is left to the caller — this contract's single job is 'did enough guardians sign these bytes'.
guardian_set_rotation: The set index is PINNED at construction. A VAA declaring any other index is refused rather than trusted: rotation is governance data, and a contract accepting whatever index it was handed would accept a set nobody told it about. Rotation therefore needs a redeploy, on purpose.
verify_it_yourself: npx tsx scripts/gen-vaa-fixtures.ts   # fetch a fresh attestation from Hermes
